title: Repository Structure
purpose: Defines the repository layout and top-level separation of concerns.

normative_requirements.text: The repository shall separate repository-spec source, product-spec source, schemas, derived docs, and tooling into distinct top-level areas.
The repository-specification root shall be `repo/specs/repo/`, the product-specification root shall be `product/specs/product/`, and the two roots shall remain distinct authoritative domains.

The repository shall reserve `product/specs/product/level-0/`, `product/specs/product/level-1/`, `product/specs/product/level-2/`, and `product/specs/product/level-3/` as the conceptual product-specification Level roots, along with `product/schemas/product/` and `product/derived/specs/product/`.

An initialized repository may omit product-specification files until product planning activates the product-specification system, but repository specifications shall not be placed under `product/specs/product/` and product specifications shall not be placed under `repo/specs/repo/`.

The repository manifest shall govern discovery of repository specifications only, and the repository shall reserve `docs/overview/`, `docs/decompositions/`, and `docs/plans/` as the canonical roots for governed directional and planning documents without allowing those documents to become repository-workflow authority.

The repository shall reserve `repo/profiles/github/` as future reusable GitHub profile source material, `.github/` as the current installed GitHub adapter location, and the canonical development-document roots as the locations for their respective top-level controlling documents and subordinate chunk directories while keeping all of them subordinate to accepted repository specifications.

Remote hosting-platform deployment state shall remain outside repository content and shall be represented only through explicit evidence or declared deployment-state records rather than ordinary generated artifacts.

The repository shall require deterministic root-index or README links to every governed development-document root so repository-local discovery does not depend on filename guessing or conversation history.

The target one-repository layout shall place reusable framework and repository material under `repo/` and product-owned material under `product/`, while preserving explicit authority and discovery boundaries between those trees.

The maintained repository root shall contain exactly the following governed entries: directories `.github/`, `docs/`, `product/`, `reference/`, `repo/`, `scripts/`, and `user/`; files `.gitignore`, `AGENTS.md`, `LICENSE`, and `README.md`. No other maintained root entry is permitted without governed revision of this specification.
The `reference/` tree shall remain a separately classified reference boundary and shall not be treated as either the reusable `repo/` tree or the product-owned `product/` tree.

The repository shall reserve `user/` for non-normative user-facing convenience and session-support artifacts; content under `user/` shall remain subordinate to accepted repository and product authority and shall not establish or override repository, product, workflow, planning, validation, or implementation semantics.
